text: Foundation extraction through MIG-400 is green, but downstream removal cannot begin safely. Live ScalaFIM declares Scala 3.4.2 while the immutable Gale, Ravel, and foundation line declares 3.7.4; the recorded consumer probe shows Scala 3.4.2 cannot read TASTy 28.7. MIG-500 therefore requires an explicit compiler-line decision. Recommended route: upgrade ScalaFIM and its affected dependency graph to 3.7.4 in a dedicated clean worktree, then add immutable reframe4s pins and migrate consumers. The current ScalaFIM checkout is also 122 commits ahead with extensive unrelated modifications/deletions, so it is not a safe migration worktree.
